Hi Alice, Rishi — thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses below and next steps.

SOC 2 scope and KMS/GPU:
- Current SOC 2 Type II (2025) covers our control environment for the hosted API and inference runtime, including GPU clusters managed by Redwood and our key management service integrations for customer keys (KMS). The report lists infrastructure and access controls; specific infrastructure-level diagrams are available on request.

GAPs / HIPAA coverage:
- Our existing controls map to HIPAA Security Rule controls; we have customers operating under HIPAA with signed BAA and additional compensating controls. If FinCo needs PHI-handling certification, we can propose a scoped plan to ensure explicit HIPAA control coverage and evidentiary artifacts.

Questionnaire and attachments:
- I updated the Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_FinCo.xlsx with answers (see attached).
- Attached: SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025.pdf (same as Rishi shared) and a short evidence index (evidence_index.txt) listing where to find logs, audit trails, and penetration test reports in our shared drive.

Compliance roadmap (high-level):
- ISO 27001: Initiate gap assessment Q1 2027, remediation Q2-Q3, certification audit target Q4 2027 (12-15 month path depending on remediation scope).
- SOC scope expansion: If FinCo requests expanded scope for inference/GPU/HSM at a more granular level, we can add ∼3–6 months to audit preparation and timelines depending on control additions.
- FedRAMP: Preliminary feasibility assessment required; expect a 12–18 month program with partner cloud sponsor engagement and potentially additional continuous monitoring investments. We recommend starting with a pre-assessment call if this is a strict requirement.

Next steps / deliverables:
1) Updated questionnaire (attached) — please review and let us know any follow-up items.
2) Evidence index and links: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/shared/finco-compliance-2026
3) Proposed roadmap doc (I'll draft a short one-pager and share by COB Wednesday 2026-11-24).
